overloads.semanticRole: Establishes every One-to-Many relation for oneTable at once, regenerating the current selection of each related Many table based on the current value of each related field in the One table.
Establishes the single One-to-Many relation for oneField, regenerating the current selection of the related Many table.

constraints: Each call regenerates the current selections of the affected Many tables from scratch, and loads the first record of each new selection as the current record.
